title: How Does Sperm Volume Actually Increase?

shots.line: Every ad online promises more sperm volume.
shots.scene: Max's bedroom at night, moonlit window and city skyline; Max sits on the bed edge, face lit by his phone; insert: phone shows a tacky ad - ink salesman in an orange tie, 'MORE VOLUME!' and '300%!!' stickers bouncing

shots.line: Here's the twist...
shots.scene: Fast push into the phone; the ad text glitches and freezes

shots.line: it's barely sperm.
shots.scene: Giant face close-up (bigFace) of Max, eyebrows up, 'surprised'; thin scope bars flick on

shots.line: Sperm make up only about two to five percent of the total.
shots.scene: Zoom into the blueprint void: the tall VOLUME CYLINDER rises; a thin CREAM sliver fills the bottom with tiny tadpole dots; gold '2-5%' pops; the rest is a dashed outline with a big '?'

shots.line: So how does that volume actually go up?
shots.scene: TITLE CARD 'HOW DOES SPERM VOLUME ACTUALLY INCREASE?' (Fredoka, glow) over a blurred wide of Max at his window

shots.line: First, find the factories.
shots.scene: Max turns and clicks a flashlight; the beam becomes a blueprint scan line that wipes down the frame

shots.line: Sperm are made in the testes, then stored in a coiled tube, the epididymis.
shots.scene: Clinical side-view blueprint schematic draws itself (bladder top, prostate below, seminal vesicles behind, testis and epididymis bottom); magnifier ring on the testis: cream dots form and slide into the coiled epididymis

shots.line: But most of the fluid comes from the seminal vesicles, tucked behind the bladder.
shots.scene: Track up the vas deferens to the back of the bladder; the two seminal vesicles light up AMBER; label 'SEMINAL VESICLES'

shots.line: They supply roughly two thirds of it, packed with fructose, a sugar that fuels sperm.
shots.scene: Split vertical: top, macro of amber fluid with glowing hexagon 'FRUCTOSE' icons; bottom, the cylinder fills amber to ~2/3, gold '~2/3' pops; a sperm dot touches a sugar icon and wiggles faster

shots.line: The prostate adds most of the rest: a thin, zinc-rich fluid full of enzymes.
shots.scene: Prostate below the bladder, ringed around the urethra, glows TEAL; inset 'Zn' tile and enzyme icons; teal stream fills the cylinder gap; label 'PROSTATE'

shots.line: At release, the streams merge. A muscle ring seals the bladder.
shots.scene: White nerve pulses along the ducts; cream, amber and teal streams converge in the urethra and travel down and out; the bladder-neck ring snaps shut

shots.line: If it fails, semen flows backward.
shots.scene: Coral 'FAIL' inset: ring open, mixed stream curls up into the bladder with a coral arrow; cylinder level drops

shots.line: So volume is mostly glands refilling. The biggest lever isn't a pill. It's time.
shots.scene: Kitchen counter under a warm pendant lamp; Max eyes a giant pill, flicks it off the counter, looks up at the glowing wall calendar; mini cylinder hologram refills

shots.line: Skip a few days and volume climbs. Wait too long, and sperm get sluggish.
shots.scene: Insert: calendar pages flip DAY 1, 2, 3 while the volume meter climbs; pages keep flipping to DAY 10+, a sperm dot yawns, 'SWIM SPEED' meter dips into coral

shots.line: Age, low testosterone, and prostate drugs like dutasteride can all shrink it.
shots.scene: Three vertical cards: Max ages (grey tuft) and gland dims; a 'T' gauge drops; generic 'DUTASTERIDE' bottle and the cylinder shrinks; coral down-arrows

shots.line: But taking testosterone to fix it backfires.
shots.scene: SIGNATURE FREEZE: Max reaches for a generic 'T' gel tube; flash; world freezes, dust hangs, cool tint, corner badge 'TRAP'

shots.line: Your brain sees plenty and shuts sperm production down.
shots.scene: Vertical blueprint: brain/pituitary top, bloodstream middle, testis bottom; gold 'T' floods the blood, coral feedback arrow to the brain, LH/FSH lines fade, sperm factory goes dark; footnote 'usually reversible after stopping'

shots.line: Supplements? Zinc probably only helps if you're low.
shots.scene: Clinic room: Dr. Ada (violet scarf, glasses) by a lightbox; Max shows the phone ad, the salesman shrinks away; ZINC bottle fills a 'LOW' gauge, extra bounces off at 'NORMAL'

shots.line: CoQ10 may help sperm swim. Give it three months.
shots.scene: CoQ10 bottle: a sperm dot gains a gentle speed trail; lightbox calendar shows gold '~3 MONTHS'

shots.line: Ashwagandha raised volume in one small trial.
shots.scene: Ada lifts the ASHWAGANDHA bottle; data card PLACEBO vs EXTRACT bars, stamped '1 SMALL STUDY - 46 MEN'

shots.line: A sudden drop? Talk to a doctor.
shots.scene: Max's mini cylinder flashes coral; Ada calmly gestures to a 'UROLOGY' door sign; Max nods

shots.line: So sperm volume is really gland volume.
shots.scene: Back in the night bedroom, same framing as the opening; the phone ad gets a transparent blueprint overlay of the whole system, colours flowing correctly

shots.line: Time, hormones, plumbing...
shots.scene: Gold words pop down the frame on the beat: TIME / HORMONES / PLUMBING

shots.line: and almost no sperm.
shots.scene: The full VOLUME CYLINDER returns and zooms to the tiny cream sliver at the bottom; Max smirks at camera and swipes the ad away
End screen: 'What should we take apart next?' in Playfair italic, comment bubble, Max and Dr. Ada lined up; loops back to the cylinder
